notes: Chocolate: the seven bars come to about 835 kcal, roughly 38% of the day so far. They're also most of the ~120 g of sugar, more than double the usual ~50 g daily guideline.

Protein: about 63 g, mostly from the pho. At 116 kg, roughly 150 g a day (about 1.3 g per kg) is a sensible target for someone lifting twice a week, so today is about 40% of the way there with one meal left.

Energy: maintenance at 116 kg is probably somewhere around 2,500–3,000 kcal a day, depending on height, age and activity. At ~2,200 kcal so far, dinner decides whether today lands under or at maintenance.
Accuracy: the pho and doughnuts are the big unknowns (±150 kcal each). A realistic range for the day so far is 1,900–2,500 kcal.
days.plan: Make dinner protein-first and low in sugar: about 200 g of cooked chicken breast, lean steak or fish (~60 g protein) with rice and veg. That's around 600 kcal and ends the day near 2,800 kcal and ~130 g of protein. If the goal is weight loss, go lighter on the rice and keep dinner closer to 400 kcal.
days.training: Legs twice this week with a rest day in between is good frequency. Make the next session upper body so your legs get 48–72 hours to recover.
